summary: A workflow definition is a composition of versioned parts, and each step is defined in exactly one part; the registry compiles compositions, and no released definition version is retained for history. The decision model sets each work item's size and its minimum steps, proof, and testing; a task that proves bigger than its size reruns the model and continues in the same item. Sized workflows record define start and merge-queue entry.
title: Workflows are composed from shared parts, and a decision model sets each work item's size
